title: DMMA College of Southern PH grad tops customs brokers licensure exam
summary: A graduate of DMMA College of Southern Philippines scored the highest grade in the recent licensure examination for customs brokers, the Professional Regulation Commission said.

blocks.text: A graduate of DMMA College of Southern Philippines scored the highest grade in the recent licensure examination for customs brokers, the Professional Regulation Commission said.
According to the PRC, 2,377 test takers out of 3,440 passed the exam, given by the Board for Customs Brokers in Metro Manila, Butuan, Cebu, Davao, Koronadal and Lucena.
DMMA's Krenz-Vincent Secretaria Buduan achieved the top score of 91.67%, while the best-performing school with 40 or more test takers is Adamson University, with 55 of 60 examinees passing.

"The result of examination with respect to one (1) examinee was withheld pending final determination of his/her liabilities under the rules and regulations governing licensure examinations," the PRC added.
